## TRA Timeline

#### Planned Up-C IPO and form-of TRA

- 2021-09-03: Confidential DRS describes planned 85% Up-C TRA
- 2022-01-19: First public S-1 filing under Registration No. 333-262245
- 2022-01-27: Form-of TRA filed as Ex 10.6 to S-1/A No. 1 (unexecuted, preamble placeholders)

#### Registration withdrawn

- 2022-12-19: RW filed (accession 0001104659-22-128136); IPO abandoned, TRA never executed

## Explanation

Dynasty Financial Partners Inc. filed a planned Up-C IPO registration in 2021 and 2022 with an accompanying form-of Tax Receivable Agreement that would have paid 85% of realized tax benefits to existing OpCo members and their permitted transferees. The contract was designed to capture basis step-ups under Sections 704(c)(1)(B), 707, 732, 734(b), 737(c)(2), 743(b), 754, 755, and 1012 arising from the planned Initial Sale, Redemptions, and Direct Exchanges, plus pre-existing basis adjustments and imputed-interest deductions on TRA payments. The form-of TRA appeared only as Exhibit 10.6 to the January 27, 2022 S-1/A (placeholders `[bullet], 20[bullet]` in the preamble, blank signature pages), and no subsequent S-1/A refiled it. The IPO never closed: the firm filed a Registration Withdrawal Request on December 19, 2022 for Registration Statement No. 333-262245, fixing the TRA's status as never executed. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
